verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a chartered bank offering banking-as-a-service, but nothing in the evidence documents program-level limits, approval stages, or a path to raising limits. The only limit-related items are customer-configured per-account-number ACH limits (column-comm-7), overdraft enablement, and custom roles. These are controls the platform sets for its own users, not documentation of the bank's program limits or how to increase them.
